title: 🕑 Dedicated 24/7 Assistance
h1: Round-the-Clock Support for International Patients in India
intro: Traveling abroad for medical treatment can feel overwhelming — but with us, you are never alone. Our dedicated 24/7 assistance team is available day and night to ensure your journey in India is smooth, safe, and stress-free. From the moment you contact us until you return home, we provide continuous guidance and personal care

sections.heading: 👩‍⚕️ How Our 24/7 Assistance Helps You
points: Before Arrival: Guidance on visa, travel, and treatment planning
During Stay: Airport transfers, hospital admissions, doctor appointments
Emergency Support: Immediate response in case of medical needs
Daily Assistance: Help with accommodation, meals, and translation
Post-Treatment Care: Follow-up support after discharge and return home

sections.heading: 🌍 Why Patients Value Our 24/7 Service
points: Personal Patient Coordinator assigned to every patient
Multilingual support (Arabic, Russian, French, African languages)
Assistance with local SIM cards, banking & daily needs
Direct coordination with hospitals & doctors
Emotional support for patients & families far from home

sections.heading: 🩺 Examples of 24/7 Support
points: Arranging urgent consultations with specialists
Handling last-minute travel or hospital requirements
Emergency medical help (ambulance or ICU support)
Translation and interpretation during medical discussions
Guiding families on sightseeing & recovery activities

sections.heading: 💰 Cost of 24/7 Assistance
points: Included FREE with our medical tourism packages
Premium add-on for extended personal care or in-home nursing

cta.headline: 📞 Get 24/7 Patient Support in India
points: Always available
